purpose: Field registry for the Segmentation Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen topic candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name only.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity for segmentation method selection.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise family phrase from the Layer 1 registry and verified method evidence.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates Bayesian, graph, transformer, unified deep, spot-detection, and joint classification approaches.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input picture for the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing rather than parameter lists.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes transcript-coordinate, image-plus-transcript, fluorescence-image, and tissue-image routes.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Segmentation.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only the segmentation, transcript assignment, spot detection, or joint segmentation/classification role.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps boundary methods scoped to segmentation rather than downstream annotation or general image analysis.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short object-level phrase such as cell boundaries, transcript assignments, detected spot coordinates, or segmented/classified objects.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates spot-level outputs from cell-level segmentation and assignment outputs.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen topic set.
fields.fill_rule: Use two to four local alternatives only.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports branch-local comparison without global ranking.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides branch-local selection logic for segmentation use cases.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement only.
fields.fill_rule: Use the coarse label supported by the registry and method evidence; do not infer runtime readiness.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a branch-local resource gate for later review.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures practical constraints without creating execution claims.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger images, large molecule tables, multiple fields of view, or atlas-scale segmentation.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Be conservative unless public evidence directly supports a label.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps identify methods that need extra scrutiny for large imaging-based spatial transcriptomics datasets.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official documentation location.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when an official or clearly primary code/documentation source is confirmed.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides a traceable code source for later engineering review.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes direct method evidence from review or community-use evidence.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note on what is direct evidence and what is Layer 2 synthesis.
fields.fill_rule: Use one to two concise sentences. Mark comparison, burden, and risk fields as synthesized when appropriate.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps uncertainty and evidence strength visible.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Do not write default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method misuse without claiming runtime failure.

fields.name: Segmentation Branch
fields.definition: Topic branch represented by the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value matching the primary role in the frozen Segmentation topic.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents spot detection and image classification rows from being mistaken for transcript-to-cell segmentation rows.

fields.name: Primary Segmentation Signal
fields.definition: Dominant signal used to identify spots, cell boundaries, or cell assignments.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value. Use mixed only if no single signal dominates.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates transcript-first, image-first, graph-first, and nuclei-anchored decision routes.

fields.name: Transcript Assignment Role
fields.definition: Whether the method directly assigns transcripts or spots to cells.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes cell-level assignment methods from upstream spot-detection methods.

fields.name: Annotation Coupling
fields.definition: Whether segmentation is coupled to annotation, classification, transfer learning, or external reference information.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value based on direct method claims; use unclear if the coupling is not explicit.
fields.topic_relevance: Makes annotation-driven or reference-influenced segmentation choices explicit.

fields.name: Modality Fit
fields.definition: Coarse modality or data setting where the method primarily fits within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports branch-local routing by technology and input type.

fields.name: Boundary-risk Caveat
fields.definition: Concise scientific caveat about segmentation boundary risk, spot-level limitations, reference bias, annotation coupling, or benchmark limitations.
fields.fill_rule: Use conservative free text. Do not convert the caveat into a severity score unless later evidence justifies that.
fields.topic_relevance: Makes scientific-critical-thinking concerns explicit in method selection.
